QUOTE: "`resolved = (tier1 or tier2 or tier5) ∪ tier3 ∪ tier4`" and "**Tiers 3 and 4:** these accumulate. Nothing stated can remove a target fact or an ecosystem signature."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says stated tiers replace each other (tier1 overrides tier2) while discovered tiers 3–4 accumulate and cannot be removed by anything stated.
